name: r1-a-e4-rounds-tmem
author: solx-loop
description: At L, persistent rounds that hold whole batches only (18816 tokens = 147 tiles of 128 at every HW) keep fp32 h in TMEM across per-batch GRN counters. With FP16x3 tcgen05 swap-AB GEMMs (8.2 us of MMA per round) and a block-pipelined GELU epilogue, a round should take <= 15 us, so 64,56,56 <= 170 us rented, without h ever leaving the SM. UNMEASURED: no compile or run result was obtained in this session.
